# VRS — coverage fixture

V-1 — SMB manufacturers in Metro Manila lose ≥ 8 h/week to manual inventory counts. verify: interview (n ≥ 10)
V-2 — ≥ 30 % of interviewed plant managers would pay ≥ ₱15,000/month for automated counts. verify: paid pilot
V-3 — Gross margin ≥ 60 % at worst corner (hardware COGS from anvil product-bom). verify: model
